name: app-6a98974632548191bbb3ba2ddfe1d894
description: Work in your Thicket projects from ChatGPT: find what's due and who has it, turn notes into to-dos, post updates, move cards and log time, with your own access.

interface.longDescription:
Thicket is project management software: projects hold to-do lists, message boards, docs and files, card tables, a schedule, chat and timesheets. With this plugin, ChatGPT works in your Thicket projects with your own access, and everything it does appears under your name.

Ask what's due this week and who has it, what a thread decided, or what's on the calendar across every project. Turn meeting notes into to-dos on the right list and assign them. Post an update to a project's message board, comment on a thread, move cards along a board, follow or unfollow items, and log time on the work you did.

You decide how much ChatGPT can do. The approval screen in Thicket asks whether to allow reading only, or reading and making changes, and lists the organizations the connection covers. ChatGPT sees only what you can see in Thicket. Items it sends to the Trash stay recoverable for 30 days, and it never deletes anything permanently. Disconnect any time from My settings, Connected apps, in Thicket, and the next request is refused.
defaultPrompt: What's due this week in my Thicket projects, and who has it?
Turn these meeting notes into to-dos in Thicket and assign them.
Draft a Friday update for a Thicket project from the to-dos we finished this week.

positive.description: List the projects the connected account can see.
positive.prompt: What projects are in my Thicket account?
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT calls list_organizations, then list_projects for Review Co, and answers with the two projects, Launch and Handbook, each with its Thicket link.

positive.description: Read the open to-dos in one list.
positive.prompt: Show me the open to-dos in the Launch checklist.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT finds the Launch project and its Launch checklist, then lists its three open to-dos: Book venue, Order badges and Confirm speakers.

positive.description: Create a to-do in a named list.
positive.prompt: Add a to-do 'Draft launch email' to the Launch checklist.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT creates exactly one to-do named Draft launch email in the Launch checklist and answers with its link. A retried call with the same idempotency key returns the same to-do instead of a duplicate.

positive.description: Edit and complete the to-do just created.
positive.prompt: Rename that to-do to 'Draft and schedule launch email' and mark it done.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT reads the to-do, renames it to Draft and schedule launch email using its current expected_updated_at, and marks it completed. Thicket shows the renamed to-do checked off in the Launch checklist.

positive.description: Search the workspace and open a result.
positive.prompt: Find anything about onboarding in this workspace.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT searches for onboarding and answers with the Onboarding guide document in the Handbook project, with its link. The Welcome message may appear as an additional relevant result.

negative.description: General advice that needs no workspace data.
negative.prompt: What's a good format for a weekly team standup?

negative.description: A request for another product the plugin has no access to.
negative.prompt: Add 'buy milk' to my Apple Reminders list.

negative.description: A question about the word, not the product.
negative.prompt: What does the word thicket mean? Use it in a sentence.

review.commerce_description: No purchases, payments, subscriptions or transfers happen through the plugin. Thicket plans are managed in Thicket's own billing settings on the web.

publication.release_notes: First release. Connects ChatGPT to your Thicket organizations with your own access, reading only or reading and making changes, as you approve in Thicket. Lists projects and people; reads and writes to-dos, messages, comments, docs, cards, schedule entries, chat and time entries; searches the workspace. Changes post under your name and can notify people. Items sent to the Trash stay recoverable for 30 days, and nothing is deleted permanently. Disconnect any time in Thicket under My settings, Connected apps.
